## What’s new

Orion now starts with a verified source, keeps source choices focused, and recovers more clearly when playback has trouble.

## Better playback

- VixSrc is now the primary source on Desktop and Mobile.
- Sources that no longer meet Orion’s playback checks no longer appear.
- Source switching keeps your saved place whenever the selected source supports it.
- Orion’s popup, navigation, and playback protection stays active.

## Better trailers

- Trailers now use the same reliable playback flow on Desktop and Mobile.
- Blank or unavailable trailers automatically try a safer path or the next trailer.
- The redesigned trailer window follows your Orion theme and works better at smaller window sizes.

## Safer updates

- Updates download and verify inside Orion.
- Improved recovery from interrupted updates.
- Clear confirmation after Orion updates successfully.

## Fixes

- Improved playback reliability, resume behavior, and update handling.
